Welcome to my website! I am currently working as a Financial Stability Expert at the European Central Bank on topics relating to financial stability and systemic risk. In early 2026 I return to the Central Bank of Ireland to work as a Senior Economist in the Irish Economic Analysis Division.

**Research interests** Banking, artificial intelligence, financial stability, systemic risk, international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks
